provenance.paper_title: StreamArena: Toward Continuous, Interactive, and Long-Horizon Agentic Streaming Video Understanding

evidence.paraphrase: Backend workers asynchronously build persistent evidence memory.

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Historical records are reused instead of rebuilt for each query.
During operation, StreamMind applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to persistent audiovisual evidence; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.
Fixed backend workers condense stream history. For StreamMind, this specifically supports episodic or hierarchical summarization of persistent audiovisual evidence.
During operation, StreamMind applies relinking or reindexing of stored items to persistent audiovisual evidence; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are explicitly linked for downstream retrieval, reasoning, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 5): During inference, the operative memory component (persistent audiovisual evidence) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, episodic or hierarchical summarization, relinking or reindexing of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
